# Chapter Fifteen: War (The Gathering Storm)

WAR

The line of trees hid the soldiers as they passed between the large trunks, using the brush to mask their positions. Rogan smiled as he watched them moving, rushing from place to place as his soldiers lined up, getting into position, he did not hurry them, enjoying the sight of the nervous figures flitting back and forth. The Silvan’s had weeks to setup, he knew they had a plan, traps and probably contingencies should his army make it all the way into the territory. Right now, though they didn’t know what his plans were, what his abilities were and more importantly what he was going to do. “Captain, lets get the men into position, we march in thirty minutes, I will be standing in the Silvan’s border city by evening, is that understood” Rogan yelled to Captain Postric, the overweight middle aged soldier rushing about as he herded and organized the lines for battle. “Yes, my Lord Seer” he answered, his breathing hard from the stress.

“They will not give up territory without a fight” Lord Seer Kol Bores said atop his own horse next to Rogan. Hiding his face behind the black kowl Rogan rolled his eyes at the man. He was no General nor did he understand anything about battle, his comment was not only obvious but completely stupid Rogan thought, putting a smile on his face and turning to the other Lord Seer “Yes, they will” he simply answered. Rogan went back to watching the soldiers as his heart pumped faster with excitement, he knew he was a sight to see, the long black robes and polished silver pauldrons gleaming in the morning sun. He sat straight and proud in the saddle looking over the troops as they pulled swords and rifles, the soldiers strangely quiet he thought on this the eve battle.

This was true power he reflected, power over another person, power over a nation was won by the sword Rogan smiled as he imagined the gold lioness spreading across the North and east until it filled every corner of the continent. He would be her champion, at the vanguard of her army bringing nations to heel for his Empress he mused. “So, they are waiting for us, are we just going to march at them as targets for theyre amusement” Seer Bores snarked interrupting Rogan’s daydream. He turned to reguard his peer, well peer in name only to see the malicious sneer on his face. His flat blue eyes and full red cheeks framed that sneer Rogan shook his head the man was not only an idiot he didn’t realize when he was out of his depth thought Rogan motioning over the treeline. “Do you really think I would simply sacrifice the Empresss troops, we have need of them, though they are only mundane’s they are a resource we plan to utilize in the coming year Lord Seer and not one we want to waste” Rogan finished and nodded to Captain Postric. The captain skuttled over to the center of the line and rose a blue flag waving it twice. At the termination of the second wave, the front rank stepped forward and left and from behind bowman appeared, arrows topped with odd cans. With a smile Rogan motioned for the captain to proceed. Postric rose a red flag and the first line of troops turned, lighting the wicks on the can’s using crystal heaters. The bowman waited a full three seconds and then fired high and into the treeline where they landed. Rogan smiled nodding to the woods and Boren scoffed but looking anyway as the can’s popped and smoke began to drift upward. “Now we are the ones approaching under cover” he said and with that the troops began to move forward, spears, swords and rifles held out in front of them as they began to run, the entire flood of soldiers moving swiftly towards the treeline. Rogan could hear shouts of surprise from the woods and his smile grew even wider. The smile froze on his face, quickly becoming a grimace as a barrage of blue energy leapt from the forest, then another and another.

They were firing blind, but the number of rounds coming out of the woods were astounding, Rogan had never seen anything like it as the soldiers began to drop and line after line fell to the barrage. Then the soldiers were in among the trees, coming through the smoke and entering the woods proper. Rogan could no longer see them, but he could hear the sound of metal hitting metal and screams of pain and victory. Holding his breath, he waited for a moment and then with a motion of his hand began moving forward another line of troops at his heels. From the smoke two figures emerged, the clothing was that of the wardens, they raised rifles the likes Rogan had never seen and calling power to his hands he launched electricity t them, the two wardens flying backwards into the smoke.

More wardens emerged from the smoke and Rogan threw fire and electricity hitting each one and sending them reeling back into the smoke. The Lord Seer stopped at the edge of the forest as the cans of smoke burnt out and the air began to clear he motioned with his hand and a scream erupted from behind him as the second line charged into the woods.

Rogan watched as the Wardens fought, holding the line and driving back the troops but another smile appeared on the Lord Seer’s face as screams erupted from behind him and before the Wardens could turn and look, pale gaunt figures flew over the heads of the soldiers and descended on the wardens, claws flashing and as Rogan watched his eyes bright with enjoyment he watched two wardens erupt into flames as one of the Screamers threw a gout of fire before returning to mauling the Warden under him.

Elemental Magic, Blue Energy and steel flew through the group and was quickly paid in blood as soldier and then warden and then screamer fell, bloody and dead. Rogans eyes went wide as he watched the Warden’s rally, slender pistols emerging from holsters as they began to fire repeatedly, without reloading. Rogan’s eyes went wide he had never seen its like as blue lines of energy trails put off by the crystal resin cartridges filled the air as soldiers and screamers alike fell to the line of Wardens.

Rogan stared in disbeif, the battle had been won, it had been almost done, what were these weapons and where in Aurtus’s name did they get them. He heard Postric sound the horn and knew the soldiers were regrouping, as he watched the wardens back pedaled up the hill, covering there retreat with more fire from rifles and pistols, rounds firing one after another without the need to reload. He could see the soldier’s eyes; knew they were scared and knew they meant to flee. Anger surged through his body as his hands lit with blue flame. Before the soldiers could take another step, he flung it to the ground and will his will spread out a line of the flame cutting the soldiers off. “Fight or die” he screamed meeting their eyes, they could be afraid of the enemy he thought, but they would surely be more afraid of him. The soldiers turned, mustering what little courage they had and rushed after the retreating Wardens.

As they reached the hill the soldiers were emboldended by the lack of weapons fire and rushed up the hill, surging towards the direction the wardens had disappeared. Then in an instant the entire hill was engulfed in an explosion as part of soldiers rieghned down on the two Seers. “Hold Back” Postric called but it was too late, more explosions erupted from in front of them and more chuncks of meat landed raining down around the small group on horseback. The Screamers flitted through the trees rushing after the wardens as they ignored the screams before.

Before they could disappear over the hill Rogan watched as another barrage of gunfire fell half their number before the remaining Screamers retreated further up the trees. “Bring them back Postric, we make camp” Rogan said flatly turning and seeing the smile on Seer Boren’s face. “I take it it didn’t go as well as you wanted it to Lord Seer” he asked feigned commiseration in his words. Rogan eyed him and turned away heading back to his carriage and supply camp.

Two hours later Captain Postric stood before him in the newly erected tent two miles from the front. Rogan sat in the large wooden chair reguarding the captain cooly he could see the sweat pouring down his brow as his eyes darted back and forth. Rogan didn’t speak, only watched the other man for a while getting enjoyment from the Captains abject fear. What was it about a man who thought he was going to do he wondered surpressing a smile as he imagined Postric peeing himself? “What happened Captain, I mean we had the advantage, we made the treeline and then what happened?” Rogan asked leaning forward the angry edge in his voice causing the Captain to flinch.

“I, I don’t know sir, those weapons I have never seen anything like them, they didn’t need to reload they just kept firing and firing and then the explosions, I had expected some traps, but nothing like that my Lord” he began and Rogan cut him off. “Whatever those weapons were, I want them, once we conquer this land we will have those weapons for our troops on the eastern border, but for now, what is our plan Captain, we need to take the city” Rogan stated Postic looked up and the Lord Seer could see the hope in his eyes “Yes, Yes my lord” he stammered his mind racing as he straightened, becoming the military commander yet again. “Sir, if we send troops up to disable the bombs, they will kill them we will be sacrificing troops over and over to dismantle the bombs, They own the high ground and they will slaughter us my lord” he finished keeping his eyes averted as he waited for the wrath of the Lord Seer. Rogan sat there and reguarded the Captain “Mundane’s have there uses, but it looks like I will need to bail you out, get our troops ready for the morning Captain, we take that hill” he said and with a wave of his hand dismissed the Captain. Postric bowed deeply and then all but ran from the tent.

“You know, in hindsight, is it possible that the Empress should’nt have killed all her generals during the changeover?” Boren said entering from the side of the tent. Rogan winced, the great purge as it had now known was the night, she had taken her chosen, assasins moved on every senior level advisor and military leader gutting the top level of the crown, leaving only her and the chosen to rule. “We have this Boren; I have a plan, but it will require you as well” he said irritated. He would have to trust the other Lord Seer and that he wasn’t sure he could do. Rogan sighed, he had little choice if they were to take the hill then he would be the one to clear it, with those guns the wardens carried he would be fired upon and without Boren there to protect him, Rogan would die.

The Lord Seer sat in one of the dining chairs in the middle of the tent, smiling at Rogan. “This should be interesting” he merely said his eyes alight with humor.

The next morning as the sun rose Rogan and Boren emerged from the tent to find Postric waiting for them horses saddled and ready. The three rode down the hill and to the forward camp, Rogan looked around and noticing at least half the soldiers they had brought with them were no longer present and shook his head. “Postric, send your messengers out, we need more soldiers and now” Rogan stated, and the captain merely nodded as they continued into the camp.

The two seers waited, watching as the soldiers mustered gathered into a line they waited, and Rogan sighed looking at his fellow Seer and motioning him to join him. “You ready Boren” he said and walked towards the woods. As he approached a single shot rang out and blue energy ran into a shield four feet from Rogan’s body, causing him to flinch. Boren laughed “I am always ready My Lord” he said as the two entered the forest and after a short walk, soldiers mustered and following them they stood before the hill, Rogan could see the burnt bodies and ditches where explosives had gone off, turning his soldiers into so much meat.

Boren stood behind him and random shots continued to hit the invisible shield the other Seer now held out in front of them. Rogan began to gather power, his runs feeling hot as he pulled more and more into himself, when he no longer could pull anymore the runes starting to burn Rogan thrust out his arms sending a powerful burst of kinetic energy twenty feet wide rushing up the hill. Trees exploded, flying forward as traps were triggered and random explosions went off as the wave of energy hit them. After a moment the entire group looked up the hill, seeing the newly formed road the Seer had created with a wave of his hands.

Rogan felt tired, but still had a little more in him he thought and motioned for Boren to follow. They walked up the hill coming to where the energy blast had ended and Rogan again called forth power, pulling it from every crystal he could sense, he pulled until onve again his skin burned and then with another push, released the kinetic blast and watched as trees dropped and explosions went off, when it was done another two hundred feet had been cleared in front of them. The Wardens knowing what this meant increased fire, trying to drive back the Seers but Rogan merely stood there a moment, doing his best to stay on his feet, he didn’t want to show the wardens how weak he was. After a moment he turned slowly and walked back to the camp, flinching every time he heard the thump of a round on the shield.

Once back at the camp Boren, Rogan and Postric gathered “My lord, that was amazing, but I fear that the Wardens will not allow that to happen again” he said doing a horrible job of hiding the worship and awe in his voice. Rogan smiled it was good to show the mundane’s why Mages ruled he thought. “I know Postric, now we fight, gather the men we push towards the city” he said and turned to go. “My lord, it is very possible that we will lose a lot of men, the Warden’s are dug in, they have the knowledge of the woods and we haven’t even faced the Silvan’s yet” Postric said. Rogan paused turning to face the Captain. “Then you best get more soldiers here Captain, we will take this city, the Empress commands it” he said. “Will you use the contingency?” Boren asked as the Captain left earshot and Rogan turned towards the fellow Seer, all humor was out of his words and the look he gave him was serious.

The Lord Seer thought about it for a moment, he had not wanted to, he had hoped to save the contingency until they took the east, but things were falling apart here” Finally he nodded “I fear we will have to, but there may be hope the soldier can take it without revealing our hand” he said as the two retired to a newly erected tent put up for them to rest.

Two hours later they emerged from the tent revilatized after there rest. Rogan lifted his head as he listened to the sound of gunfire and screams, the soldiers were at it he thought. Mounting his horse he rode into the treeline and quickly found the rear of the assault. He watched as soldiers rushing up the hill were gunned down, some making it, most not and returning fire then hunkering down to reload as others ran past repeating the process. The Wardens had those weapons, they could continue to fire laying down round after round, but the soldiers were gaining ground because of the sheer numbers. Rogan watched as Wardens began to fall back, soldiers moving further up the hill and just before he smiled in approval he watched as new soldiers entered the battle, moving high up through the trees as they leapt from branch to branch, forty of them in total quickly gained position over the soldiers and began to fire down upon them raining death from above. “The Silvan’s are here” Boren said flatly, and Rogan winced as entire legions of the Empress’s soldiers fell dead on the field. “Boren tell them to bring up the wagons” he said, and the other seer turned leaving the woods.

Twenty minutes later eight wagons that looked more like rolling jail cells came to a stop in the camp. Rogan walked out of the treeline reguarding the carriages and then with a wave of his hand, the doors ripped off each one and as they did, screamers fell from the door, crawling across the field, shrieking and jabbering. Closing his eyes Rogan reached out and felt their minds like the Empress had taught him he pushed his will, his orders at them and the creatures quieted.

After a moment he opened his eyes to find the entire group of over a hundred staring at him silently. “Go, kill” he simply said, and they launched themselves into the woods. Rogan turned and rushed after them.

He had been hoping to keep the existence of so many of the creatures quiet until they attacked the eastern kingdoms, but he was going to lose if he did not do something to change the tide in this battle. Rogan watched as the screamers took to the trees climbing as if they too were born there, jumping from limb to limb they attacked, the Silvan’s firing but there were too many and as the lords of the trees came to battle, they fell one after another to the ground, the screamers slaughtering them but not without loss Rogan thought as he watched the Silvan’s fire into the mass of oncoming creatures, some falling to the ground dead.

The wardens began to fall back once again, the tide turning as his remaining soldiers pushed forward. Rogan followed behind, his shield keeping him alive as he took the hill. Coming over the top he could see the profile in the distance of his target, the City in the trees. Rogan smiled, his prize was there, the Empress’s spoils were there and now it was within his sight. As his soldiers and screamers took the field advancing towards the retreating Wardens and Silvan’s he was about to declare victory when the enemy crossed a line of brush and it erupted with blue fire, lines of energy and crystal rounds exploded by the thousands from the brushline, taking the entire first wave of soldiers and Screamers and tearing them to pieces. “Retreat” he called, watching as the second line was slaughtered as unseen guns firing thousands of rounds continued to pour fire into them.

Rogan tried in vain to throw up a shield to protect his remaining troops and the Empresss prized creatures but the rounds tore through it, there were so many rounds he couldn’t hold it long or wide enough to protect them all. The soldiers and screamers fell back, falling further to the bottom of the hill. Postic barking orders, setting up gun mounts and shooters to try and keep the ground they took.

An hour later Rogan walked through the camp of mostly wounded soldiers and spotting the thirty creatures out of over a hundred that were left, huddled in the bushes, cowering the Empress would not be happy he thought. Most of the troops were dead or wounded, leaving him only about three thousand able bodies left, the Silvan’s had access to technology that Rogan couldn’t have predicted, surely the Empress could understand that he thought returning to his tent. As he walked Postic came to walk next to him “My Lord, I have sent out the messengers to request more troops” he began, and Rogan stopped. “I am sending a missive to the Empress, we need more of everything, if we are to take this city, we will have to throw everything we have at it” he said and then entered his tent.

The captain looking on in surprise.
